Definition: Whether identity records are stored in electronic/digital format versus paper-based records
Comments: ONI maintains a centralized electronic database with 7.2 million CNIB records. Civil registry (DGMEC) remains largely paper-based, though iCivil is being deployed digitally. The primary ID issuance system (ONI) is fully digital/electronic.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Confirmed via additional sources: ONI's own site and the Burkina Faso national police both describe the CNIB as a centralised, biometric (fingerprint since inception, facial biometrics added 2009) electronic identification database, corroborating the World Bank ID4D diagnostic. However, that World Bank source is dated 2017 (against a 2024 year tag) and ONI's own 2023 objectives include a goal to build an electronic archive for supporting application files ('fonds des dossiers'), indicating some paper-based document archiving persisted into 2023 alongside the digital core database. Value Code 3 (Digital) is confirmed for the core CNIB system but a fresher primary source is lacking; flagged for human review on the currency of evidence.

Definition: Whether credential is accepted or mandatory for SIM card activation and mobile service registration
Comments: The CNIB is mandatory for SIM card registration in Burkina Faso. Tanager International (2023) explicitly states: 'Even buying a SIM card for your mobile phone is impossible without the national identity card.'
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: The original citation is a single anecdotal NGO blog. Stronger evidence found: Burkina Faso's Ministry of Digital Transition (mdenp.gov.bf, March 2023) confirms Décret n°2018-1270/PRES/PM/MDENP/MSECU (31 December 2018) makes prior identification compulsory before any SIM card or telecoms service can be sold, and a 2022 legal analysis (Africa Data Protection) confirms operators must verify subscriber identity data against the ONI database (arrêté n°2021-0789/MSECU/SG/ONI). This corroborates Value Code 3 (Mandatory) with authoritative government/legal sources; code confirmed.
